verdict.rationale: Restate is a durable-execution platform rather than an agent, so publishing an official MCP server applies. A probe reports an official MCP server documented on the AI-assistant page, and those docs say Restate's documentation integrates with coding agents like Claude Code, Codex and Cursor. That suggests a docs-oriented MCP integration, but the pack shows no details of what it exposes or how to connect. Missing for 10: setup and connection docs for the MCP server, its tool/resource scope (e.g. operational control of services and invocations versus docs lookup only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Restate documentation and templates integrate with AI coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, and Cursor
